description: Legacy model-based cost figure in EUR, with human-provider and robot-automation comparisons. AstraNL currently has zero recorded real price observations for this service. This tool does not create an estimate case and does not provide a reviewed quotation. For the real case engine use estimate_case_create, then estimate_case_status and estimate_case_answer; use estimate_case_files for photos/plans and estimate_case_video for video intake. Do not invent dimensions. Legacy arguments and response fields remain unchanged.

area_m2.description: Surface area or working volume in square meters. Optional but improves accuracy. For non-area tasks (e.g. plumbing repair) pass 0 or omit.

category.description: Service category. Same enum as create_task.

location.description: City in the Netherlands. Pricing varies by region (Amsterdam tends to be highest). Optional — omitting uses national median.

name: estimate_cost
